_readme: Copy this file to tools/espn-config.json (gitignored) and fill in the cookie values.
espn_s2 and SWID are live ESPN session credentials for whoever's account they belong to.
Never commit them, never paste them into chat, never put them in a public repo.
Each league needs credentials from someone who is a MEMBER of that league.
To get them: log in at fantasy.espn.com in Chrome, open DevTools > Application >
Cookies > https://fantasy.espn.com, and copy the values of 'espn_s2' and 'SWID'
teamMap is only needed if the script cannot auto-match a team: {"F3": 7} pairs
site team F3 with ESPN team id 7.
